# Europa Special Tours

> Europa Special Tours creates tailor-made short breaks and getaways in Europe for travelers with limited time, specific interests, and a travel budget below EUR 5,000 per person.

## Website
- Home: https://www.europa-special-tours.de/en-us/
- Travel ideas: https://www.europa-special-tours.de/en-us/reiseideen.html
- Personalized trip finder: https://www.europa-special-tours.de/en-us/einstieg.html
- Contact and inquiry: https://www.europa-special-tours.de/en-us/kontakt.html

## Experiences and campaign pages
- Wellness and relaxation: https://www.europa-special-tours.de/en-us/qr/wellness.html
- Wine and food: https://www.europa-special-tours.de/en-us/qr/genuss.html
- Cities and culture: https://www.europa-special-tours.de/en-us/qr/stadt-kultur.html
- Rhine in Flames: https://www.europa-special-tours.de/en-us/qr/rhein-in-flammen.html

Travel themes may include wellness, city breaks, wine, food, spirits, history, folklore, nature, and family escapes. Hotels, childcare, event dates, and services are checked for the requested dates and remain subject to confirmation.

Inquiries below EUR 5,000 per person for long-haul travel may be referred here from the Asia, Africa, and Latin America inquiry forms. Personal contact details and free-text messages are not transferred; only the referring brand and a standardized interest category may be included.

Company details, contact information, and required legal notices must be confirmed before publication. The responsible contracting party and contractual terms must be made clear in every offer.
